PROVIDER: Google Gemini (100% Free Tier via Google AI Studio)

FREE_TIER_BENEFITS.rate_limit: 15 requests per minute at zero cost

HOW_TO_GET_FREE_API_KEY: Step 1: Open https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey in your browser
Step 2: Sign in with any regular Google / Gmail account
Step 3: Click the blue 'Create API key' button
Step 4: Copy your key (starts with AIzaSy...)
Step 5: Paste it above between the quotes in GEMINI_API_KEY: "AIzaSy..." and save this file
ALTERNATIVE_CONFIG: You can also paste this key in your .env file as GEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSy... or enter it directly in the top-right '⚡ AI Key' button in the chat interface!
